subject: Information Theory
title: AI and Human Knowledge
description: Learn AI and Human Knowledge in one minute.

hook.text: GPT-4 passed the bar exam, the medical licensing exam, and an AP Biology test. AI now encodes expert-level knowledge.

buildup.text: Large language models compress humanity's written knowledge into parameters. They're databases of civilization.

discovery.text: AI democratizes expertise. A farmer in rural India can access medical advice that once required a specialist.

twist.text: AI also hallucinates—generating plausible but false information. Users can't always tell when the model is wrong.

climax.text: The future of knowledge is hybrid: human judgment guided by AI's vast processing power. Neither alone is sufficient.

punchline.text: AI knows a lot. It doesn't know what it doesn't know. Humans must.

quiz.question: What is the main risk of AI as a knowledge source?
options: It can generate plausible but false information (hallucinations)
